narr: A shortwave trough supported a swath of heavy rain along a PWAT gradient with values as high as 1.9 inches across far southwestern Pennsylvania and northern West Virginia. 500-1000 J/kg of MUCAPE and 20 knots of cloud bearing flow supported thunderstorms producing heavy rain and flash flooding.
